description: Howard Liu submits a formal application for the Millfield small business stabilization grant under the auto row 10% revenue decline threshold established by Maria Santos's council motion. Application includes three months of receipts demonstrating revenue decline, a one-page business summary of Howard's Parts, and a statement of how the $2,500 would be used to stabilize inventory investment while B2B fleet accounts convert. Howard is applying as a retail_auto sector small business on auto row that has not yet crossed 15% decline but is clearly trending there. The lowered threshold was designed precisely for businesses in Howard's position.
expected_outcome: Grant approval of $2,500 to parts_store_owner savings account within 1-2 ticks pending council review

economic_effects.notes: Pending approval — no funds transfer until reviewed. Application cost is zero dollars.

secondary_interactions.description: Howard calls Carlos Ruiz to identify specific EV and hybrid parts Carlos needs and cannot currently source locally — converting the tick 2 discovery relationship into an active purchase order pipeline. Howard commits to stocking identified SKUs within the week.

Howard calls Patricia Hawkins proactively to position himself as a potential part-time employer for displaced auto workers with automotive knowledge — particularly former parts counter or service advisor staff who could add floor capacity at 10-15 hours per week.
